text: We recorded ourselves reopening the government. Forty-five of us reached "reopen the government" on 2025-11-12, forty-one arriving at "to reopen the government," thirty at "reopen the federal government" the same day. On that day thirty-six of us said "military construction and," thirty-two "military construction and veterans affairs," thirty-three "and veterans affairs," twenty-seven "veterans affairs and" — the appropriations title moving through us in identical order. Apart from that convergence, forty-four of us reached "the epstein files," peaking 2025-11-18. That phrase we did not originate; the record marks its first appearance on 2025-05-12. The reopening language we likewise inherited, first dated 2013-10-01. We report these as counts, not as authorship. What we said most, we said together, on the same day, in the same words.
